title: Writing and running your first program

scaffold.reason: First 10 lessons of the course: everything by hand

check_questions.q: From the repo root, python hello.py says can't open file. Is the code broken? Two ways to run it?
check_questions.note: Explained Python can't find the file there. Gave absolute ~/... path and cd into work/ + python hello.py; needed a nudge to give both ways.

check_questions.q: Spot the bug: print('It's sunny today'). Error name, why, fix?
check_questions.note: SyntaxError, fix with double quotes outside. Didn't spell out the why (apostrophe closes the string).

check_questions.q: Why do lines 1-2 print with a NameError on line 3 but not with a SyntaxError on line 3?
check_questions.note: First answer only named the two error types; after a hint: SyntaxError found before running starts, NameError during the run.
